facts: Designs, manufactures, and services critical digital infrastructure for data centers.
Offers AC/DC power management, switchgear, UPS, power distribution, thermal management, and energy storage solutions.
Operates as a power management company.
Offers power distribution assemblies, power quality, connectivity, circuit protection, and utility power distribution products.
Operates as an integrated retail electricity and power generation company in the United States.
Reports approximately 44,000 MW of generation capacity across gas, nuclear, coal, solar, and battery storage.
Provides intelligent sensing and power solutions.
Its Power Solutions Group offers semiconductor devices for power conversion, switching, signal conditioning, and circuit protection.
Its end markets include AI data centers.
Focuses on silicon-carbide materials and devices for power applications.
Offers silicon-carbide wafers, epitaxial wafers, Schottky diodes, MOSFETs, and power modules.
Its industrial and energy applications include AI data centers, grid modernization, renewable energy, and storage.
